_about: Numeric-limit regression rows (controlled numeric fix, 2026-10-09). 'evidence' is VERBATIM eCFR body_text from the local read-only snapshot (table cfr_records; snapshot_date and SHA-256 of the whole paragraph per row); it is NOT exact model-prompt evidence. 'claim' is CONSTRUCTED for testing unless claim_provenance says VERBATIM, and is not regulatory text. 'credited_before': production credited this correct claim before the change (measured in Phase 2M); the change must keep it credited. Do not edit.
